device: iPhone 15, iOS 26.x (or the newest release), Safari tab and Home Screen app; floor device (Q-10): tier mobile-low at 30 fps; operator Preview

steps.instruction: Build one Preview (pnpm map:build -- --area synth && DV_WORLD=synth VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build && pnpm deploy:preview). Write the Preview URL into notes.json as previewUrl.

In Safari (a tab, not the Home Screen app) open the Preview URL and pass Title, age and Terms. The Share > Add to Home Screen coach card must show once on the main menu; close it, open Settings and come back: it must not return. Write what you saw into notes.json observations.

In New Game type a profile name with the OS keyboard, including an emoji and a name longer than 24 characters: the emoji and the long name must be refused inline with the message under the field. Note any layout shift when the keyboard opens in notes.json observations.

In landscape, in the Safari tab and again in the Home Screen app (Share > Add to Home Screen, then launch from the icon), open the Preview URL with ?debug=1 and record in notes.json safeAreas.safariTab and safeAreas.homeScreen: innerWidth, innerHeight and the four computed env(safe-area-inset-*) values (top, right, bottom, left, in CSS px). They are recorded, not asserted (U-UI-10).

Home Screen app, landscape, ?perf=1&tier=mobile-low: finish the creator (Done) and play on foot for 5 minutes with the touch layout: stick, look drag, Jump, Camera, phone and pause buttons; open the phone and the pause menu a few times; enter and leave a car. The HUD (clock, wallet, prompt, minimap frame) must stay readable and inside the safe areas. When the 5 minutes end tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M04b2/iphone15/.

While playing, turn the phone to portrait: the rotate card must cover the screen and the game must pause; turn back to landscape: it must clear and the game must run. In the main menu, portrait must show the menu with no rotate card. Write the result into notes.json observations.

Settings > Controls > Touch: turn Tilt steering on. Read the explainer, accept, and note in notes.json tilt what the browser did (a permission prompt, a denial, or nothing) in the Home Screen app. If it is denied, the toggle must fall back to off and a toast must say the stick steers instead. No acceptance criterion asserts tilt.

In the creator, turn the preview with a drag and open the Head zoom. Note whether the preview stutters (it is a menu scene on the shared canvas); if it does, say so in notes.json observations: the fallback is a 30 fps turntable.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M04b2/iphone15/perf.json --tier mobile-low --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M04b2-iphone15.json: the median and p95 frame times (30 fps at mobile-low), the frames over 50 ms and the render and triangle counts must pass at mobile-low.
